actionCalls.name: OPEN_SAFETY_WINDOW
actionCalls.description: Opens or activates the A-pillar blind spot safety visualization window HUD on the automotive display.

mode.description: Visualization view mode for the safety window

actionCalls.name: SET_SAFETY_SENSITIVITY
actionCalls.description: Adjusts the sensitivity level for risk prediction and blind spot obstacle detection.

level.description: Sensitivity tier for warning triggers and early school-zone activation

actionCalls.name: CHECK_DRIVING_SAFETY_SUMMARY
actionCalls.description: Queries and speaks the current driving safety status, risk score, and detected hazard summary along the route.
